subject: Affordable Housing Trust Declaration and Action Plan
overview: The board reviewed its foundational Declaration of Trust and established a schedule for a five-year housing action plan. Members also evaluated long-term revenue strategies including linkage fees, short-term rental taxes, and the sale of city-owned property.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from September 4, 2024.

items.title: Declaration of Trust Draft Review
items.summary: The board reviewed a draft governing document, discussing trustee removal procedures, City Council oversight for land sales, and the inclusion of housing policy advocacy in the board's powers.

items.title: Action Plan Timeline and Methodology
items.summary: A working group outlined a multi-phase schedule involving data collection through the end of 2024 and community engagement meetings in early 2025, targeting a final plan by April.

items.title: Stakeholder Engagement List
items.summary: Members refined a list of regional developers, service providers, and advocacy groups to be invited for focus group sessions to inform the action plan.

items.title: CPA Application Update
items.summary: The board prepared for an October 22 presentation to the Community Preservation Committee regarding its application for funding and potential projects on city-owned lots.

items.title: Finances and Funding Sources
items.summary: The board discussed implementing housing linkage fees, requiring a nexus study, and exploring revenue from meals taxes, short-term rental fees, and the sale of underutilized municipal land.

items.title: Invitations to Discuss Housing Resources
items.summary: The board agreed to invite managers of federal and state housing funds, including CDBG and the North Suburban Consortium, to present at future meetings.
